41-46 macaw optional: green + clean guam (herb bank / spectres).

74-86 granite lobster: crimson + granite 500g (Desert Quarry).

88-89 unicorn stallion: green + unicorn horn (Zilyana Asgarnia GWD / unicows Tower of Life Kandarin).

Exact pouch counts: wiki Summoning calculator; do not treat bar counts here as optimizer XP/h.
Green charms priority (wiki ironman guide): Croesus (x20 random colour per kill, EGWD Misthalin working taxonomy) > abyssal walkers > mithril dragons.
Crimson charms priority: Croesus > Nex > Araxxor > waterfiends > corrupted scorpions (aggression potions) > celestial dragons.
Waterfiends: Ancient Cavern (Kandarin) and related waterfiend spots - strong crimson AFK/task source.
Kalphites / exiled kalphites (Desert): ironman Slayer guide flags exiled kalphites as a good blue-charm + herb-seed source on task.
Charming moths (Forinthry/Wilderness): all charm colours via Hunter; also catalogued as Hunter method and summoning:charming-moths-hunter-charm-supply-.
Celestial dragons crimson/tertiary overlap already catalogued under summoning:celestial-dragons-steel-ingots-water-talismans-crimson-charms.
methods.region_note: Primary planner region misthalin via Croesus as top green/crimson priority; treat moths/waterfiends/kalphites as alternate region routes, not hard locks.
